discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators and the quantum spin Hall effect
rationale: Recent prizes covered quantum information (2022, 2025), attosecond physics (2023) and machine learning (2024). That makes a condensed-matter discovery a plausible next pick. Topological insulators are a long-standing frontrunner with major citation impact and Breakthrough, Dirac and Oliver Buckley prizes. Kane and Mele made the theoretical prediction and Molenkamp's group gave the first experimental confirmation of the quantum spin Hall state in HgTe quantum wells. Shoucheng Zhang died in 2018, so the slot goes to the experimental discoverer.
